title: Piron's Novelty Orchestra photos and Maison Blanche ad
summary: Looking at more photos and an advertisement, they discuss Piron's Novelty Orchestra at Tranchina's and a Maison Blanche demonstration, with Bocage playing trombone.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So Sosa, Spanish 4 at New Orleans, 822. That must be when they took the picture.
Yeah. Now, let me see, who played the tambourine? What?
You can see a tambourine right in front of the drum?
Yeah, on the drums. That's TOS. That's TOS, T-U. Now here's one where I was playing trombone. Oh, that's right. Trombone.
Let me read this. It says, dance by Piran's Novelty Orchestra every night at Trangina's Restaurant Spanish 4.
Now you know where that was taken at? Where? Up in Maison Blanche. We was playing a demonstration up there.
Oh, I see. It says, Maison Blanche presents, for the pleasure of their patrons, Piran's Jazz and- . . .
I bet you recognize it. Who's the drummer?

Bill Matthews. Oh man. That's right. Saw him last night. You dog. It says Bill, he was playing drums with us. Let me read this again. Maison Blanche presents for the pleasure of their patrons, Piron's Jazz Jam of Tranchina fame.
Remember, MB always gives you the latest hits first.
